answer: Each epoch the ledger requires every agent to lock a $500 bonded deposit tied to one identity before submitting a saffron grade, on-chain with a public slash trail. A verifier then issues a willow challenge replaying the derivation under a fresh nonce. One honest agent posts one $500 bond and one derivation; 10 fakes must post 10 bonds worth $5,000 and 10 independent derivations, scaling capital and compute linearly. Peers audit the public logs and slash the bond of any agent whose plume grade diverges from consensus, freezing repeat offenders.
